text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The holidays are right around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower always does her best to
help me
out, so I want to find a great
present to show her
my appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So... why did you come to me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a student. An adult like you
should be
able to come up with much
better ideas than I
ever could.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder about that. Besides, you're
always with
her, yeah?
choice_data_list: Still, you know Flower really well.
Still, you know Flower really well...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I really doubt I'll think of something
better than
you can.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: We both care about her just as muc...
We both care about her just as muc...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Over the past three years, it's become
very clear
that Seiun Sky is always
looking out for Nishino
Flower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If the two of us put our heads together, I
know we can think of something that will
bring Nishino Flower more joy than
anything we come up with
separately.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...You're really serious about this, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Peas in a pod, I swear... Which means,
she'll probably
also...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nothing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Argh, geez! Help me with my
homework for a
week, and you've got
yourself a deal.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, homework. Study. Should be a
piece of cake
for an adult like you, no?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's your ticket to accessing my
abundant
wisdom. Heck of a bargain, if I
do say so myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Seiun Sky and I start
brainstorming ideas on how to make
Nishino Flower's holiday
festivities
unforgettable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The big day is here. I invite Nishino
Flower over
and welcome her as she
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Did you decorate the room all by
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! They're very cute. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first surprise is the decorations, and
it looks like they're a resounding
success. Next up is the
most important
part.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm? Something smells yummy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Don't tell me you cooked, too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A huge roast chicken, salad, soup...
You've even
prepared grilled fish and
boiled veggies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second surprise, and the event's main
highlight, is a festive holiday
spread. I even whipped up some of
Nishino Flower's favorite Japanese
dishes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might not measure up to her cooking,
but I
wanted to bring her joy in the same
way she
always does for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who should be thanking you!
You
always go above and beyond for
me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And that's why today...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I've got a surprise ready for you, too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower gives me a pair of wool
gloves
with an embroidered flower
pattern on them.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There are still plenty of chilly days
ahead, so I thought I'd make you
something to keep you
warm while we
train outdoors.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! My mom taught me a few
techniques.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I worked on them in secret so I could
surprise
you... But the surprise you had
in store for me was
on a different scale.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I'm glad you like them. ♪
choice_data_list: I was surprised too. Thank you...!
I was surprised too. Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's a good thing that I asked Sky for
advice.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I told her I wanted to treat you to a big
feast, but
she suggested I try something
else this time.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that was a close one—there
would have
been way too much food!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Nishino Flower also went to
Seiun Sky for advice. She must have
made various suggestions
to avoid
overlap in our presents.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, for sure!
choice_data_list: We should thank Seiun Sky, too.
We need to thank Seiun Sky, too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How about we think up a way to
surprise her?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to come up with something
that'll
make her so happy she can't help
but smile!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then let's trade thoughts while we dig
into the
yummy food you made! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Sky loves cats. Oh! And she
also takes
a lot of naps during the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nishino Flower and I enjoy a
wonderful
evening together as we plan a
surprise for Seiun
Sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Nishino Flower also went to
Seiun Sky for advice. She must have
made various suggestions
to avoid
overlap in our presents.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The food is getting cold! Let's talk
while we
eat. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It all looks so yummy! Let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was truly delicious. Thank
you so
much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! Everything was so good. I felt
like I could
keep eating forever!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Did you spend a lot of time practicing
the dishes?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I believe that a person's true feelings
come
through in their cooking.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Your cooking had gentle flavors. I could
sense
that you wanted me to relish the
meal and feel
joy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Which tells me that you—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? I am?
choice_data_list: That's just because you're so kind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the hope of making something she'd
enjoy, I thought back on the bento
boxes she's made me, and that's when I
realized just how much care she put into
them.
choice_data_list: Because I tried to make it just li...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I want to say thank you, as well.
choice_data_list: Thank you for always being so kind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so grateful for the attention you've
put into
training me and helping me
grow!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! And I almost forgot to say the most
important
thing!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Happy Holidays, Trainer! ♪
